name: Weapons of Spirit
label: Quest
description: Witch Doctor Uzer'i now has everything needed and the spirits you captured. Binding them into weapons is hard work, so Uzer'i asks you to wait a moment…
intro: Witch Doctor Uzer'i now has everything needed and the spirits you captured. Binding them into weapons is hard work, so Uzer'i asks you to wait a moment while the preparations are made.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Imbuing the muisek into the weapons is a difficult process. Now that I have all of the required materials and the muisek of the creatures that you captured, I may begin. Please wait; I will return in a moment.

clips.title: Completion
paras: As promised, you have your choice, friend. The muisek of the creatures has been forever sealed into the power of these weapons.
You may now wield their energy as your own. Use it well.
